page_title: OSA 2-4 RMA | Osasuna v Real Madrid 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's it for today, Juan Martinez Munuera has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+4' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries his luck with a long-range shot, but the ball crashes against the bar. Great effort!
90+1' 2 - 4 Iker Munoz (Osasuna) latches on to a precise pass deep inside the box from Jesus Areso, and he beats the goalkeeper with a low shot into the middle of the goal. He makes it 2:4.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
88' A goal, which was scored by Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid), was disallowed due to offside.
87' Real Madrid take a short corner kick.

87' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to place a shot inside the right post, but Sergio Herrera makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
86' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Rodrygo, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Vinicius Junior leaves the pitch and Arda Guler (Real Madrid) comes on.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) replaces Ferland Mendy.
81' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
79' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Jorge Herrando will be replaced by Juan Cruz (Osasuna).
77' The substitution is prepared. Lucas Vazquez (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Toni Kroos.
76' The attendance for today's match is 22430.

75' What a wasted opportunity by Rodrygo (Real Madrid)! He creates some space for himself inside the penalty box and unleashes a decent strike towards the right side of the goal, but Sergio Herrera makes an astonishing save to thwart him.
72' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nacho Fernandez (Real Madrid) replacing Eduardo Camavinga.
72' Here's the change. Brahim Diaz leaves the pitch and Luka Modric (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
70' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Ante Budimir and he is replaced by Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
70' Substitution. Moi Gomez is replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
70' The referee signals a substitution. Iker Munoz (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Alejandro Catena.
69' Substitution. Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jose Manuel Arnaiz walks off.

67' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) latches on to the corner kick and releases a quick strike from the edge of the box. The result differs significantly from his intention as the ball flies way over the crossbar.
66' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) will take the corner.

64' An amazing individual effort from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) ends with a strike from inside the penalty area. He sends the ball precisely into the bottom right corner and makes it 1:4. Sergio Herrera was helpless.
63' Unai Garcia (Osasuna) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
63' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
62' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

61' 1 - 3 Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Sergio Herrera is just a bystander as the ball flies into bottom right corner. The score is 1:3.
58' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Real Madrid out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
55' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) will miss the next game.
54' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
53' The game is interrupted now, Moi Gomez (Osasuna) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
53' Yellow card. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
52' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
51' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
50' The resulting corner from Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) is cleared.
49' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Osasuna will have a goal kick.
48' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle for an infringement.
46' Referee Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
44' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
43' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
42' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

41' Andriy Lunin makes a brilliant save! Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
40' Shots on target – 1:4.
38' The resulting corner from Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
37' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
34' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
33' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) tries to find Rodrygo with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
31' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
30' Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
28' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
25' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
24' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends an accurate short pass. Brahim Diaz controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
20' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
18' 1 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) was set free in the area by Federico Valverde and made no mistake with a lovely finish into the left side of the net. 1:2.
16' Osasuna fail to score from a corner as Andriy Lunin (Real Madrid) leaps to collect the ball.
16' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save. Osasuna will take a corner kick.
15' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Sergio Herrera easily deals with the threat.
14' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
13' The referee awards a corner and Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) goes over to take it.
12' The game is interrupted. Johan Mojica (Osasuna) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
11' Real Madrid string together a series of short passes.
8' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Sergio Herrera.

7' 1 - 1 Jorge Herrando produces a sweet pass and picks out Ante Budimir (Osasuna) inside the box. He quickly takes a shot which goes into the bottom right corner and leaves the goalkeeper helpless. He makes it 1:1!
7' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
5' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.

4' 0 - 1 GOAL! A terrible mistake leads to a goal. The defender ends up losing possession, allowing Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) to pick up the ball before slotting it into the back of the net to make it 0:1.
1' The first half has started.
Osasuna will kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera will referee today's match.
